body.name: Ze
body.type: nonnegative essential-feature polynomial indexed by \(e\in\mathcal I_T\)
body.def: For \(e=\operatorname{dir}(i,j)\), \(Z_e(T,p_T)\) sums the probability of exogenous response contexts for which the table of \(j\) differs at some two endogenous parent assignments that differ only at \(i\), with the existential comparison ranging over every table input including off-support assignments. For \(e=\operatorname{src}(C,j)\), it sums over two positive-mass values of the child-set source \(U_C\) and the other-source contexts for which the table of \(j\) differs at some endogenous input assignment. Each summand is a zero-one table indicator times a monomial in \(p_T\).
